results.text: How do I use the Food Map?
results.answer: Food Map has Community browsing for everyone and, after login, My Map plus personal Statistics. Community shows shared discoveries; My Map contains places owned by your account; Statistics summarizes your private journey. Use the mode switcher to move between them.
